infoCards.title: Quality Assurance
infoCards.description: End-to-end quality management system ensuring automotive standards and compliance.

faqData.question: How does the system handle supply chain management?
faqData.answer: Our system provides end-to-end supply chain visibility with real-time tracking, supplier management and just-in-time inventory optimization.

faqData.question: Can it integrate with existing automotive production systems?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution supports integration with major automotive production systems, PLCs and quality control equipment through standard industrial protocols.

faqData.question: What kind of quality control features are available?
faqData.answer: The system includes comprehensive quality control features including inspection planning, defect tracking, compliance monitoring and automated quality reporting.
